name: [Volontariapp] Erreurs serveur gRPC élevées ({{service.name}} / {{resource_name.name}})
query: sum(last_10m):sum:trace.grpc.server.request.errors{env:prod AND rpc.grpc.status_code NOT IN (1,3,5,6,7,9,11,16)} by {service,resource_name}.as_count() / (sum:trace.grpc.server.request.hits{env:prod} by {service,resource_name}.as_count() + 100) > 0.05
